title: Add discriminated game-export types for players
description: The current `schemas/game_export_types.py` models all exported players with one broad `Player` `TypedDict`, so code that has already narrowed `player["type"] == "pilot"` still has to treat `model` as optional. That forces membership checks in leaderboard and analysis helpers, and makes it easy to silently skip malformed pilot rows instead of failing fast. Split `Player` into discriminated variants keyed by `type` so pilot-only fields like `model` can be indexed directly after narrowing.
